plugin.name: WireGuard
plugin.description: Install WireGuard on your hosts and manage interfaces, clients and configs from one tab.

use.title: Use WireGuard
use.description: Manage WireGuard interfaces and clients on hosts you can edit.

tab.title: WireGuard
tab.error: Could not load WireGuard from this host.
tab.sudo: This host needs a root login or passwordless sudo to manage WireGuard.

install.title: Install WireGuard
install.desc: This installs the WireGuard tools and iptables with the host's package manager.
install.empty: WireGuard is not installed on this host
install.noManager: No supported package manager was found. Install WireGuard by hand.
install.hint: Install it on {{os}} to run a VPN from this host.

interfaces.empty: No interfaces yet. Add one to start a VPN.

create.title: Add interface
create.name: Name
create.addressHint: The server address and subnet. Clients get the next free addresses.
create.natDesc: Clients can reach the internet and the host's network through this host.
create.natMissing: NAT needs iptables, which is not installed on this host.
create.forwardingDesc: Lets the host pass traffic between clients and the network. Saved for reboots.
create.firewall: Open the port in the firewall
create.firewallDesc: Adds the UDP port to ufw or firewalld when one is running.
create.startDesc: Turns the interface on and keeps it on after a reboot.

detail.gone: This interface no longer exists on the host.

enable.label: WireGuard
enable.description: Show the WireGuard tab for this host in its menu.

showPanel.label: Show WireGuard panel in terminals
showPanel.description: Let the WireGuard panel open beside this host's SSH terminal.

alertDown.label: Alert when an interface is down
alertDown.description: Send an alert when an interface that starts at boot is not active. Checked when the WireGuard status is read.

settings.endpointHint: The public address clients connect to, like vpn.example.com:51820.
settings.allowedHint: The ranges clients send through the VPN. 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0 sends everything.
settings.keepaliveHint: Keeps clients behind NAT reachable. Use 0 to turn it off.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the WireGuard panel with new terminals
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the WireGuard panel beside every SSH terminal that has WireGuard on. You can still open and close it from the button on the right edge.

companionSide.label: WireGuard panel side
companionSide.description: Where the WireGuard panel sits next to a terminal.

companionSize.label: WireGuard panel size
companionSize.description: Width in pixels, or height when it is at the bottom. You can also drag its edge.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the panel button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the right edge of a terminal that opens the WireGuard panel.

clients.name: Name
clients.nameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
clients.allowedHint: Leave empty to use the interface default: {{value}}
clients.needEndpoint: Set the server endpoint in the interface settings first.
clients.configFailed: Could not read the client config.
clients.rotateDesc: The old config stops working. Give the client the new config afterwards.
clients.deleteDesc: The client is removed and can no longer connect.

clientConfig.note: This config holds the client's private key. Share it only with the person or device that will use it.
clientConfig.qr: QR code for the client config

config.title: Config file
config.hint: Private and preshared keys are hidden. Leave the placeholder to keep a key. The config is checked before it is saved and a backup is kept. Address changes need a restart.

service.autostartDesc: Start this interface when the host starts.
service.needsSystemd: Starting at boot needs systemd on this host.
service.noForward: IP forwarding is off on this host, so clients cannot reach the network through NAT.
service.deleteDesc: The interface is stopped and its config, keys and saved client files are removed from the host.

manager.title: WireGuard
manager.disabled: Turn on WireGuard in this host's settings to use this card.

card.title: WireGuard
card.empty: Turn on WireGuard for a host to see it here.
